steps.speaker: Elderly Woman
steps.content: Oh, would you look at that! Dove just brought me yesterday. My little grandson can already write his name! ...Aw, just so adorable!

steps.speaker: Philippe
steps.content: You don't say! Can't wait to bring my family here. My little one's still so young. Maybe I'd raise her like a true DisCity-born, heh!
Désir's town center is bustled with life as ever, with townspeople chattering away. Dove's figure has blended into the crowd, making it even harder to trace.

She has repeatedly given you the slip, using datura-covered corners, hidden passages, and even well-timed passersby as cover. The chase has been relentless though, you've completely lost sight of her.

steps.speaker: Jolly Middle-Aged Woman
steps.content: Hey, newcomer, why running around? Catch a breath will ya?... Don't tell me you're playing some hide-and-seek, haha!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: No, I'm not... Actually, did you just come from the west side? Have you seen which way Dove ran off to?

steps.speaker: Jolly Middle-Aged Woman
steps.content: Ran off? Oh my, she was running, after all! Dove's been a little sickly, so it's rare to see her exert herself like that. Looks like you two are really getting into this, aren't you?
Seeing the woman's cheerful obliviousness to the urgency, you put on a more serious tone and restate your word.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: This isn't a game. I'm trying to catch her because I saw her opening letters she shouldn't have been. She might be tampering with the town's mail, possibly even forging letters.

steps.speaker: Jolly Middle-Aged Woman
steps.content: Huh? That sounds so not true. Dove's a good girl. Maybe she was just fixing some addresses?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: That's possible. But give it a thought—have you noticed how every letter has the same response time and always looks freshly enveloped? They are supposed to be from different places, right?
These discrepancies have been present all along. Even a newcomer like you can spot them, but this woman seems to be purposefully turning a blind eye to them.

steps.speaker: Jolly Middle-Aged Woman
steps.content: Oh, that's nothing to worry about! Dove's already explained it all. Miss Vautour Bleu personally entrusted the caravan to deliver our letters!

steps.speaker: Jolly Middle-Aged Woman
steps.content: They're all capable young lads, moving fast in the desert, always been so reliable. Ain't surprising they keep our letters intact! Hey, you'll get used to it once you've stayed here longer. What's impossible out there is nothing magical in Désir!
No matter how you phrase it, she's just not listening. Seeing no use in pressing further, you give up persuading her and try a different approach.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...Is it over there?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: No, it feels more like... here?
Without visual cues, tracking her through Mania-sensing alone is extremely challenging. It's nearly impossible to tell if the traces of Mania belong to Dove.
The longer you stay, the vaguer you could sense her trace amid the crowded townspeople.

steps.speaker: Elderly Woman
steps.content: I may be too old to understand you young folks' play, but I do know one thing: Dove is a good girl! You must have misunderstood her. She was probably just helping others write their letters!

steps.speaker: Philippe
steps.content: Hell yeah! You newcomers are always so quick to worry. Opening letters? I'm sure she was just sorting the mails for us!

steps.speaker: Curious Bystander
steps.content: That's right! You know some people wrote letters before they moved to DisCity. Then of course she's got to open them! How else would she know if it should be handed to the caravan?
As you run, you piece together the townspeople's words. Their reflexive dismissive attitude only makes Dove's deeds more suspicious.
She must be hiding something, and probably so do the townspeople. The key to unraveling this entire mystery is right in front of you—if you can catch Dove.
But how? Your breathing grows heavier and your legs feel like lead. You know you're approaching your limit, and Dove can be down any one of these alleys...
Swish.
Just then, a skirt's hem whips around the corner ahead. There's no mistaking it. It's Dove!
Ignoring the taste of blood rising in your throat, you break into a full sprint, closing the distance with every determined step.
